query_sampling: Same deterministic valid known-identity order statistics as original two-crop diagnostic. Actual unknown-gallery pool and independently identical unique paired keys are reported separately.
pair_metrics: Nearest strictly earlier same-known-fish positive and current-frame different-known-fish negatives; unknowns remain in actual gallery but are never negative labels.
scope: Frozen current-crop evidence only, with actual and unique paired GT/detector pools, R1/R5/mAP/AUC/EER and past gaps1/25/100. Fishpost is an exposed inherited reference; pretrained DINOv2/ImageNet have no fish fitting here, unverified external-corpus overlap. No outer-tuned representation, new-head training, old512GRU in384coordinates or native full-MOT gain/runtime claim.
